Function Cheatsheet

Source: vignettes/articles/manual-11-cheatsheet.Rmd
manual-11-cheatsheet.Rmd

The mrmhub package exposes more than two hundred functions across import, processing, plotting, and reporting. A typical end-to-end workflow uses fewer than fifteen of them, in roughly this order. This page summarises which function does what; each function name links to the full reference.

Workflow order

Stage Function Purpose
Import import_data_mrmhub() / import_data_masshunter() / import_data_skyline() Read integrated peak data
Metadata import_metadata_msorganiser() / add_metadata() Link analysis / feature / ISTD annotation
Setup set_analysis_order() Set acquisition order
Normalisation normalize_by_istd() Per-feature ISTD normalisation
Drift correction correct_drift_loess() / correct_drift_gaussiankernel() Smooth run-order drift
Batch correction correct_batch_centering() Align medians across batches
Quantitation quantify_by_istd() / quantify_by_calibration() Concentration values
QC metrics calc_qc_metrics() Per-feature CV, bias, etc.
Filtering filter_features_qc() Pass/fail features against thresholds
Reporting save_report_xlsx() / save_dataset_csv() Export final dataset

Visualisation at each stage

Plotting functions follow the same workflow logic. See Visualisation Functions for the grouped reference, or The MRMhub Workflow for a walked-through example.

Reading the function names

A naming convention runs through the public API. Once internalised, the function names are largely predictable:

  • import_data_*() — read raw integrated peak data from a given source
  • import_metadata_*() — read an annotation table from a given source
  • set_*() — assign a slot on the experiment
  • add_metadata() — attach annotation
  • normalize_by_*() — divide one variable by another (e.g. by ISTD)
  • correct_drift_*() / correct_batch_*() — apply a named correction model
  • quantify_by_*() — compute concentration values via a given strategy
  • calc_*() — compute per-feature or per-analysis metrics
  • filter_*() — apply pass/fail thresholds
  • plot_*() — return a ggplot2 object
  • save_*() — write to disk
  • get_*() — read a derived value from the experiment

See Key Concepts & Glossary for the vocabulary (MRMhubExperiment, analysis_id, feature_id, qc_type, ISTD, …).
